desc:
💣 BOMBANANA! is a chaotic 3-player bomb-defusal game built around communication, teamwork, panic, and explosions!

👥 **2-Player Mode is now available!**

🙈 Blind Monkey: Can't see the bomb, but is the only one who can interact with it.
🙊 Mute Monkey: Can read the defusal manual, but can't speak.
🙉 Deaf Monkey: Can see the bomb, but can't hear anything.

🍌 Communicate, throw bananas, work together and defuse the bomb before everyone goes BOOM! 💥

🎮 Official Roblox adaptation of BOMBANANA!
Original game by Lefto Studio & TARK Games.
Roblox version developed by FXFX Studio in partnership with the original team.
